audit.whatIsWrong: The disk chart (Skill/Olaf/Olaf/Skill/Skill/Olaf/Olaf) gave Olaf five of seven stages while Kled wins 53.91%, and it contradicted its own prose at five rows — whys[1] 'out-trade his single ramping auto', whys[2] 'bursts him', whys[3] 'his lifesteal can't keep pace', whys[4] 'you out-burst him', whys[5] 'is your peak'.
audit.why: The packet chart (Olaf/Kled/Kled/Kled/Kled/Kled/Skill) matches both the prose and the win rate: Olaf owns level 1 on Reckless Swing true damage and missing-health lifesteal, Kled owns 2 through first item, and two items levels it back out.
audit.corrected: All seven rows proposed as one group in both layers so full and content stay identical.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3] claimed Ragnarok 'deals true damage'. It does not deal damage at all.
audit.why: Riot's R text: passive armor and magic resist, activated immunity to disables for as long as he keeps attacking. Olaf's true damage is Reckless Swing (E), a separate 325-range ability that costs him health. Telling a player the ult itself burns true damage misprices every level-6 all-in.
audit.corrected: spikes[3].text and wants.foe[2] rewritten to resists plus disable immunity.

audit.whatIsWrong: The axe throw is repeatedly called 'his E' — 'E axe-toss', 'a long E cooldown', 'Land E axe-tosses'. The axe throw is Undertow (Q).
audit.why: Undertow is Q: 1000 range, flat 9s, reduces armour and move speed, and the cooldown resets if Olaf picks the axe up. Reckless Swing (E) is a 325-range true-damage melee strike on 11/10/9/8/7. A player told to dodge 'his E' will watch the wrong ability and never learn the axe-denial habit that decides this lane.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, early, wants.you[1] and wants.foe[0] rewritten with the correct slot, the 1000 range and the 9s reset.

audit.whatIsWrong: mid says Ragnarok means 'your Q slow gets cleansed'. Nothing in the kit says Ragnarok removes effects already on him.
audit.why: Riot's text grants immunity to disables while he keeps attacking — prevention, not cleansing. Whether it strips an existing slow is not in the file, so it must not be asserted.
audit.corrected: mid rewritten to say the knockback and trap will not hold him, dropping the cleanse claim.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tough It Out (W) gives Olaf a shield as well as attack speed, and no line on the page accounts for it.
audit.why: It is a 16s-at-rank-1 shield sitting on top of the trade you are trying to win with burst — but I could not fit it without displacing a correction that matters more, so it is recorded here rather than written badly.

audit.whatIsWrong: _missing/kled.json claims Undertow denies Kled's Jousting (E) and Chaaaaaaaarge!!! (R) — i.e. that it grounds.
audit.why: That comes from a derived 'grounding' flag. Riot's Undertow text says only that it damages, reduces Armor and reduces Move Speed. Per the standing rule I trusted the description over the flag and wrote no grounding claim.
audit.corrected: No text written. Recorded in notes and unverified.

edits.before: Mounted stats bully every level-1 exchange. Identify how Olaf contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Reckless Swing is 325-range true damage and his passive pays him lifesteal as he drops — do not contest the first wave.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Olaf carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Black Cleaver, Sterak's and missing-health lifesteal let him stat-check you — take the duel only with your own ultimate up.

edits.before: Olaf's E true-damage axe-toss and lifesteal out-sustain you here — keep Skaarl's health and don't trade into his axe pickups.
edits.after: Undertow (Q) slows and shreds armour from 1000, Reckless Swing (E) is true damage at 325 — keep Skaarl topped and walk his axe.

edits.before: Olaf's R (Ragnarok) makes him CC-immune and deals true damage — your knockback can't peel him off, so burst him before he ults.
edits.after: Ragnarok gives armour, MR and immunity to disables while he keeps swinging — your knockback won't peel him, so burst before he ults.

edits.before: Dodge his E axe-toss so he can't pick it up for the slow and cooldown reset
edits.after: Walk over Undertow's axe so he can't pick it up and reset its flat 9s cooldown

edits.before: Land E axe-tosses to slow you and reset its cooldown on pickup, kiting your dismount
edits.after: Land Undertow to slow and armour-shred you, then pick the axe up for a free reset

edits.before: Pop R for true damage and CC-immunity so your R knockback and trap-slow do nothing
edits.after: Pop Ragnarok for resists and disable immunity so your knockback and trap do nothing

edits.before: Olaf's level 1 is rough for you — his E axe-toss does true damage and the lifesteal heals him while you have no spammable poke, so just last-hit and protect Skaarl's mount health. The lane flips at 2: your W on-hit shotgun shots come online, and at 3 the full re-E (E through him, W-pull range, E back with the bonus return strike) plus your percent-HP Q trap shreds his bulk faster than his ramping autos can answer. Always dodge or sidestep the predicted axe path — an Olaf who can't pick his axe back up has no slow and a long E cooldown.
edits.after: Olaf's level 1 is rough for you — Undertow (Q) shreds armour from 1000 range and Reckless Swing (E) is true damage, while you have no spammable poke, so last-hit and protect Skaarl's mount health. The lane flips at 2: your W on-hit shotgun shots come online, and at 3 the full re-E (E through him, W shots, E back for the bonus return strike) plus your percent-HP Q trap shreds his bulk faster than his ramping autos can answer. Walk over the axe where it lands — an Olaf denied the pickup waits the full 9 seconds.

edits.before: This is your window. With Q trap percent-HP damage and W procs you out-trade his auto-ramp, and remount tops Skaarl back up faster than his lifesteal heals him. The key read is his R: once he hits 6, Ragnarok makes him CC-immune, so your R knockback won't peel him and your Q slow gets cleansed — don't try to kite a charging Olaf, just burst him down before he can pop it or force the trade while it's on cooldown.
edits.after: This is your window. With Q trap percent-HP damage and W procs you out-trade his auto-ramp, and remount tops Skaarl back up faster than his lifesteal heals him. The key read is his R: from 6, Ragnarok makes him immune to disables while he keeps attacking, so neither your knockback nor your trap will hold him — don't try to kite a charging Olaf, burst him before he pops it or fight on its 100s cooldown.

notes: Undertow carries a derived 'grounding' flag and _missing/kled.json builds a 'your dashes are denied' interaction on top of it, but Riot's own Undertow text describes only damage, Armor reduction and Move Speed reduction. I did not write that interaction. If the user can confirm from the League Wiki that Undertow grounds, it is worth a dedicated line, because it would change how Jousting and Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are used in every trade here. Also unwritten: Tough It Out (W) grants a shield on a 16s rank-1 cooldown, which no line on the page accounts for. Note the packet reports games as 243 while the brief header says 545.
